subject: Procurement references request — scheduling, opt-out, and substitute policy
messages:
From: Tom Reeves <t.reeves@finpay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finpay.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor references for Redwood — timeline next week

Hi Soojin,

We're finalizing our vendor review for LLM inference tooling and Procurement needs 2-3 customer references who can speak to production uptime, onboarding time, and data handling practices. Ideally someone in fintech/payments or a close adjacent industry.

Our committee meets Nov 12; are there customers available for a 30-minute live conversation next Wed or Thu (Nov 4–5)? If live isn't possible, a short recorded case study or a written Q&A would work.

Also, do you have any conflicts-of-interest or partnership limitations we should be aware of?

Thanks — if you can send names + 2 timeslots by EOD tomorrow that would help.

Tom Reeves
Head of Procurement
FinPay

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reeves <t.reeves@finpay.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor references for Redwood — timeline next week

Hi Tom — thanks for the note and the timeline. We can absolutely support. I've attached a short reference_request_form.pdf to capture topics the committee cares about (uptime, onboarding, security/controls).

Quick notes on how we handle reference requests so you're set:
- We typically offer live 30-min calls or a 10–15 minute recorded case study if scheduling is tight.
- We try not to contact the same customer more than once every 180 days to avoid advocate fatigue; if a customer declines we provide a vetted substitute from the same vertical.
- If a reference is unavailable, we can provide a redacted system screenshot and the recorded case study as an alternative.

Proposed first-pass: BrightHealth — Sarah Lin (fits fintech-adjacent, has production usage); CloudBank — Jared Ortiz (payments rails). Both have spoken publicly about latency and cost gains. Are you able to take either as a live 30-min slot on Nov 4 between 10:00–14:00 PT?

I'll loop in Ben and Marissa to confirm availability and any conflict checks.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Tom

- Live references: BrightHealth (Sarah Lin) — Nov 4, 11:00 PT (held). NimbusPay confirmed Nov 5, 10:00 PT as substitute live reference.

- If NimbusPay cannot attend, we'll provide the CloudBank 12-min recorded case study + a written Q&A as a fallback.
